findings.title: Compare coverage membership without imposing Record member order
findings.description: Coverage fields are collected in ontology entity.fields order (_current_disclosure_facts.py:94,183), but _join_population constructs expected fields in issued Record order and compares arrays exactly. A permutation with identical complete full Field identities therefore refuses. This adds an unintended restriction on valid ontology field ordering; authored selected Key order remains separately ordered and must stay unchanged.
findings.evidence: coverage-permutation.log independently confirms refusal for identical complete field membership with reversed order.
findings.requestedChange: Compare coverage fields as exact unique full-identity sets with count/duplicate checks; retain typed flags and all authored Key/endpoint ordering checks. Add a valid ontology field permutation regression.
